purpose: Propuestas estáticas para elegir VFX; no integradas ni animadas
overviewPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE polished landscape art-direction contact sheet for a top-down 2D iPhone arcade game, nine distinct VFX concepts in a spacious 3x3 grid. This is a proposal sheet for choosing future effects, not a screenshot and not pickup icons. Overall title in Spanish: "VFX · PROPUESTAS". Each panel shows a frozen peak frame of the effect with a tiny cream arrow player and two or three red circular enemies for scale. Keep the red enemies readable above the luminous effects wherever they overlap.
The attached screenshot is only a style reference: preserve the approved ice effect's distinctive flat long triangular cyan and white crystalline facets, sharp bright outlines and radial starburst silhouette. Carry that crisp faceted 2D geometry into other effects, with controlled luminous accents. Olive arena background in every panel, restrained fine border, pale text. No realistic 3D, no photoreal smoke, no fantasy characters, no detailed space scenery, no new UI buttons. Generous gutters and clear readable labels.
Panels left-to-right, top-to-bottom, labels exactly:
"1 · BOMBA": golden-orange expanding shockwave with a bright compact white core, angular orange fragments, two crisp concentric rings and short radial rays, strong but clear silhouette.
"2 · ONDA": wide purple curved energy blade travelling left-to-right, three layered crescent ribbons, bright lilac leading edge and sparse triangular trailing sparks, clearly directional rather than a circle.
"3 · MISILES": five small golden arrowhead missiles fanning from a tiny cream player, curved tapered amber trails, sharp white-gold tips and tiny impact star at one enemy.
"4 · HIELO": the already approved 2D radial ice burst from the reference: long pointed cyan/aqua flat triangular translucent crystals, twelve points, alternating white and cyan facets, sharp white outline; match its simple readable character closely, no redesign into rocks or snowflakes.
"5 · BURBUJA": translucent emerald circular shield around a small cream arrow, double thin bright rim, one local angular green impact ripple with three shell fragments. Show the player clearly.
"6 · PINCHOS": pale blue rotating shield made of twelve sharp crystalline spikes surrounding the small cream arrow, open readable center, subtle short arc motion cues. Distinguish from the large full-screen frost burst.
"7 · AGUJERO NEGRO": dark plum compact circular core, three elegant magenta-purple spiral ribbons winding inward, sparse angular particles being pulled in, a nearby little arrow and red dots still legible. Entirely flat top-down 2D, no tilted Saturn ring.
"8 · RAYOS": electric white-violet jagged branching bolts chaining between four red dots, compact sharp contact sparks, violet secondary outline, each enemy visible above the bolt.
"9 · FUEGO": small cream arrow speeding to the right leaving a curved orange-red burning ribbon, sharp angular flame tongues, white-hot leading embers and fading scattered red diamonds.
Each effect occupies about two-thirds of its panel; full effects fit without cropping. Coherent production-friendly 2D style, visually rich but few deliberate shapes, readable at phone size. The source screenshot's grid of pickups and HUD should NOT be copied. Render only the nine labelled concept panels and the modest title.
existingIce: Usuario expresa que le gusta el hielo de 0.3.2; se conserva como referencia. La lámina A es una reinterpretación generada, no una captura nativa.
attemptsNote: Primera lámina de bomba rechazada por el generador; se generó con éxito una propuesta puramente geométrica de destello radial.

sheets.title: BOMBA
sheets.brief:
Instant radial explosion at the player, golden amber palette.
"A · ONDAS": two clean circular shock rings, compact brilliant white-gold nucleus, short straight radial rays and sparse angular shards.
"B · ESTALLIDO": a bold many-pointed polygonal sunburst made of broad overlapping triangular orange-gold sheets and crisp white contour, fewer circular elements, strong graphic impact.
"C · FRAGMENTOS": bright compact central ignition and an outward halo of separated glowing golden polygon pieces, two thin broken arcs, airy readable negative space between shards. Distinguish strongly from B's connected star silhouette.

sheets.title: ONDA
sheets.brief:
A wide purple energy front travelling from LEFT to RIGHT, arrow behind it pointing right.
"A · CRECIENTES": three parallel nested crescent blades, bright lilac front with long smooth tapering ends and translucent ribbon trails.
"B · DENTADA": one wide connected jagged zigzag energy front, angular lilac teeth and white leading bevel, short triangular echoes behind.
"C · ABANICO": a broad curved front made of seven adjacent separated faceted violet energy plates, aligned like a fan perpendicular to travel; clear shallow arc and layered glasslike echoes. All three must read as travelling wide fronts, never circular explosions.

sheets.title: MISILES
sheets.brief:
Each panel shows exactly five small homing projectiles fanning from the cream arrow toward enemies on the right, gold/yellow palette.
"A · COMETAS": white-gold sharp triangular tips with long smooth tapered amber comet tails.
"B · CRISTALES": five crisp faceted golden diamond darts, chunky geometric cores and a trail of separated little bright shards, short and punchy.
"C · ORBITALES": five narrow arrowhead darts with thin double helix luminous gold ribbons trailing along curved flight paths, tiny stars at their tips; energetic flowing line work but few particles. No literal metal rockets or vehicles.

sheets.title: HIELO
sheets.brief:
A radial ice-freeze pulse with pale cyan-white flat translucent crystalline facets. This power's existing style is loved.
"A · ACTUAL": preserve the style reference's approved long narrow twelve-point ice starburst, alternating white and cyan flat triangles and sharp white edges; central tiny light, minimal glow. This is the baseline already in the game.
"B · CORONA": an open ring of large interlocking faceted cyan ice blades radiating outward, small hexagonal center and a broad transparent gap around it; angular white outlines and a few tiny shards. More hollow and ring-shaped than A.
"C · FRACTURA": a radial expanding irregular cracked sheet of ice, six broad asymmetric jagged crystalline lobes connected by thin branching fracture lines, sharp cyan-white facets; reads as icy impact, not realistic rocks or snowflake clipart. Clearly different silhouette while keeping the 2D crystalline language.

sheets.title: PINCHOS

"C · CUCHILLAS": six elongated curved faceted blade shapes orbiting around an open circle, long tapering white-cyan tips and short arc-shaped afterimages. All three have similar overall reach; do not turn into full-screen frost bursts.
